notes.title: Version 0.5.3
notes.notes:
Update notes: 

 NEW WAITING ROOM ADDED: Now all the players will have a "ready" button and all of them will be need ready to start the game, also the waiting room has a new look.
 JUMPING MOVEMENT IMPROVED: Now you can still moving in the air like in previous versions.
 VHS FILTER IN SETTINGS: The VHS filter option is added to the settings again.
 ANXIETY EFFECT IN RUN FOR LIFE LEVEL:  Now the anxiety in the player will decrease automatically in this level only.
 ADDED FEW MORE MOTH JELLYS IN DARK ROOMS
 "ALTERNATIVE" LEVELS ACHIEVEMENTS HAS BEEN FIXED
 PARKING UNLOCK HAS BEEN FIXED
 CRAWLING ACTION BUTTON HAS BEEN ADDED TO SETTINGS

notes.title: VERSION 0.5
notes.notes:
Hello backrooms explorers!!

The wait is over, after this time we bring you a new update with new interesting things!

LEVELS REWORK

A complete rework of the following levels has been done bringing with it new challenges and dangers in the game

LOBBY: The entire design was changed and new puzzles were added, making it a more challenging level to start with.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/d11759ed00b5ed74080def3da2785dbcfc982ba7.png

ABANDONED OFFICE: Complete redesign, while keeping the original puzzles, new ones were added, the secret entrances to other levels are still found in this level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/17ee86f2df1fa5064cfc5fd583c99b9ef96e6b8b.png

PARKING: A totally new design of the entire level was made, with new puzzles and a new entity that lives in this level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/bdfd1904ddefa85b11754b57d5bf7753c246969e.png

FUN LEVEL: It was redesigned but still maintains the same dynamics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/083a05293a98c8e4629d9b493f828e0204ee8cee.png

RUN FOR LIFE: New design and new challenges keeping the same objective.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/4377c8e7b35cf39f67becc342b3a764c2cdf0dc6.png

CHANGES


 Crawling: Added the ability for the player to crawl by pressing the Z key by default
 The player's stamina has increased, however, it will now drop faster if you are being chased by an entity.
 From now on the VHS effect will always be active, thus providing a more backroom-like experience.
 The position of the geiger counter in darkrooms has changed.
 New revive animations
 New settings menu.
 New match menu
 The lighting in some levels has been improved.


We appreciate your patience, we will work hard to make the next update come sooner than expected.

notes.title: Version 0.4 Out Now!!
notes.notes:
HUGE UPDATE COMES TO INSIDE THE BACKROOMS!!

Attention, brave explorers of "The Backrooms"! We're excited to introduce the biggest and most exciting update yet. Prepare your flashlight and keep your eyes open as you dive into these exciting new features:

WORKSHOP AND MODDING
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/4cadab6432fd79a46fc7e2694498b7e74b6a9e30.png
Get ready for the revolution in "Inside The Backrooms"!
With mods enabled, you can now become the creator of your nightmares creating your own custom levels and entities. The potential is limitless and we invite you to try it to the fullest!

CREATE
Do you have a unique vision for a spooky level you'd like to explore? Or perhaps a terrifying entity that wants to lurk in the shadows? With the ability to create mods, you can bring your scariest ideas to life.

SHARE
Once you've created your custom level or entity, share it with the community in the workshop. Let other players experience your unique and challenging creations!

The power is in your hands to shape the universe of "Inside The Backrooms"! Release your creativity and shape the game to your liking.

Get more information about how to make custom mods in the official discord server: 
https://discord.gg/inside-the-backrooms


NEW LEVEL
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/6da1ff27e2c5707192b149bf26b6419f0d61f6cf.png
Enter the dark and enigmatic world of the "Level 931". This level will surprise you with its lighting and vegetation, but don't let your guard down, because it also hides dark and scary places full of intriguing puzzles. And beware, a dangerous new entity lurks every step you take...

You can access this level by completing the game with the escape ending.

CONTROL THE ENTITIES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/a918d3b2463dc75aab5347a2ed6fb04e6bfb3ae4.png
We now give you complete control over your backrooms experience! With this update, you can now select which entities you would like to find in each level. This unique feature is a true game-changer that allows you to customize your adventure in unimaginable ways.


VHS FILTER
Enhace your experience with the new vhs filter, you can decide if enable or disable it in the game settings menu.


IMPROVEMENTS

 VOICE CHAT IMPROVED
 Now you can select your microphone used by voice chat in the settings.
 Clumps in sewer now don't insta kill you.
 Respawn door system improved, now it can takes you to the nearest door.
 Jumping enabled
 Stamina increased
 Running speed increased in the sewers
 Smiler now only can kill you if your sanity is very low or if you get too close.



NEW SKINS
Expand your character selection with two new skins.  The gang boss and urban guy are now part of the backrooms, you can unlock theses skins by completing some levels.



Do you have what it takes to survive in thel level? Or maybe you are ready to create your experience in the game?
Don't wait any longer and try this update! 
Hope you enjoy it!!

ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Version 0.3.0 is finally here!
Take a look to what is new in this update:

NEW LEVEL
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/ffb14af2311f0edbee4232c1ffbee6b76129cd6d.png
This level takes you through a spooky and mysterious hotel set in the 1920s, full of puzzles where you have to work together with other players to advance. Prepare to feel the tension as you explore every dark corner and face the terrifying entities that lurk in the hotel.

Are you ready to beat this challenging level? Enter level 5 of the backrooms and discover what horrors awaits you!

Important: To access this level you have complete the sewer level, if you already completed it you don't have to do it again.

NEW ENTITIES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/121c7d014eb2a8f31aca482902a30883c5c2dc5b.png

A giant moth has been spotted inside the backrooms, with another humanoid creature that wanders the terror hotel level.
You will have to face this new entities if you want to survive in the new level, but be careful,  if you see one, is better to run immediately away!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/30030aa989213478cdd55b4fb53679c9a58a0957.png

 4 NEW ACHIEVEMENTS: 
[olist]
 Easy difficulty complete achievement
 Normal difficulty complete achievement
 Hard difficulty complete achievement
 Achievement by completing the new level
[/olist]

 3 NEW COSMETICS (You can unlock these cosmetics by completing the game in all the difficulties)
 NEW ITEM: Spray Can, with this you will able to paint in the walls to don't get lost, every player will able to use it up to 10 times
 ADDED "Film Grain" option to the settings menu
 ADDED "Depth of Field" option to the settings menu


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/cd8efb57b3c4f7fc7a8e9587268063f072bae6a4.png

 SEWER LEVEL REWORKED
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350601/3904892758c3e6affe406c261083999eda5b5013.png
The sewer map has been reworked, it keeps the same puzzles, but the map style has changed.

 Now you can rebind the move control keys (W,A,S,D)
 Fixed: Code to open the grid of the run for life level sometimes didn't work
 Fixed: Sometimes the petrol puzzle in the sewers removed two cans from the inventory after interacting with it.
 Fixed: Radiation spray smoke sometimes was not sync with the host
 Safebox puzzle now is more easy to solve, now you don't have to put the numbers backwards
 Added new hint that shows the way to the respawn door



Hope you enjoy this new update!! ːsteamhappyː
